title.narrative: common cultural public events held in or related to historical cultural monuments renovated.

description.narrative: common cultural public events held in or related to historical cultural monuments renovated.

comment.narrative: 5 Public events

Due to COVID limitations several cultural public events planned to be conducted in Bender fortress had to be rescheduled. Nevertheless Youth Orchestra managed to conduct Rock Symphony Concert in Fortress in summer 2021 during short green code window. Legend of Moldova Folk Concert that was initially planned for Bender Fortress had to be conducted in Chisinau Green Theater. 8 Theater performances played by Chekhov theater in village Culture Houses renovated by CBM programme on both banks. All together 13 common cultural events since start of the programme.
